name: SETAR Colocation Datacenter
notes: SETAR's official data-center-services page describes a Tier III colocation data center announced for opening later in 2016, with dual high-capacity feeds, three backup generators, redundant UPS, shared/dedicated rack options, 24/7 NOC support, and local/international network connectivity. SETAR history records commercial launches of co-location and other data center services in 2018-2020 and cloud/contact-center services hosted in its data center in 2022. Government listing places SETAR at Seroe Blanco, Oranjestad; division assigned to Oranjestad East based on Seroe Blanco/Oranjestad location.

name: San Nicholas Data Center concept
notes: SYNRA Global published a page titled 'San Nicholas Data Center' saying San Nicolas is positioned to become an Energy + Data gateway where industrial land and subsea connectivity can support AI-ready compute, and discusses immersion-cooling partnership roles. The source does not confirm permits, capacity, site control, financing, construction, or an operating facility; included as a weak/concept-stage lead and assigned to San Nicolas South because the San Nicolas industrial/refinery area is generally in the southern part of the district.
